outcome: Composition of infant skin, oral, and anal mycobiomes
Composition of maternal vaginal and anal mycobiomes
Similarity of infant mycobiomes to maternal vaginal mycobiomes
finding: Infant mycobiomes differed by body site and were influenced by birth mode, with vaginal birth not resulting in infant mycobiomes that were more similar to the mother's vaginal mycobiome.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean section had significantly more Candida orthopsilosis fungi present in the oral cavity throughout the first month of life, while vaginally born infants had significantly more Candida albicans fungi on the skin on day 30.
